facts: Parties: Galloway Engineering Ltd (Buyer), Oakhurst Analytics Ltd (Seller); the Company is Dunmore Robotics Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 20 November 2026; Closing is scheduled for 22 January 2027 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 15.1: this Agreement is governed by English law and the courts of England have exclusive jurisdiction.

Clause 4.1: the Escrow Amount shall be released to the Seller on the date falling 18 months after the Closing Date, save to the extent of pending claims notified before that date. 'Business Day' means a day other than a Saturday or Sunday on which banks are open in London.
Clause 12: this escrow agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York and disputes shall be referred to arbitration in New York.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Juniper Logistics plc. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
Item 5: the board noted a letter before action from Yarrow Capital LLP threatening proceedings for approximately $450,000 in respect of alleged defective deliveries. Management to monitor.
